comparison.objective: Set three lock wheels to 3-1-7 and open a box lid; candidate removes and contains four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Indexed wheel rotation and lid articulation versus stabilizing a narrow mandrel while striking it and recovering millimetre-scale fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Correct wheel settings and lid opened at least 60° versus four safe fractures, retained inserts, complete containment, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Shared precision manipulation is generic; combination setting and articulated opening do not test impact fracture or loose-fragment recovery.
